data.name: Cart by Cart: Supermarket Simulator
data.detailed_description:
In Cart by Cart, you start with a small budget and an empty space. Buy your first shelves, pick your products, and build your store piece by piece. There are no complex systems, just simple, satisfying actions. Place your items, organize your layout, and turn a tiny shop into a growing business.

Open the Doors, Serve the Day

Flip the sign to “Open” and let customers in. Your store comes to life as shoppers arrive, browse, and head to checkout. Each day is a balance between preparation and service, manage your store well, and keep things running smoothly from morning to closing time.

Scan, Charge, Repeat

Every item must be scanned manually at checkout. Line them up, hear the beep, and watch the total add up. Customers will pay with cash or card, it’s up to you to handle each transaction correctly. Give the right change, enter the correct amount, and avoid losing money on mistakes.

Small Shop, Big Growth

What starts as a simple store grows day by day. Unlock new shelves, expand your product range, and fill your market with more variety. The better you manage your space and sales, the faster your supermarket evolves.

Simple Systems, Satisfying Flow

Cart by Cart is designed to be easy to understand but satisfying to master. From placing products to handling checkout, every action feels direct and rewarding. No unnecessary complexity, just a clean, cozy management experience.

  • Cozy Supermarket Gameplay: Build and manage your own small store from scratch

  • Hands-on Checkout System: Scan every item and handle cash or card payments

  • Simple Placement System: Buy shelves, place products, and organize your market

  • Day-by-Day Progression: Grow your store with new items and upgrades

  • Living Store Feel: Customers arrive, shop, and react as your market evolves

  • Clean and Minimal Design: Easy to learn, satisfying to play

data.reviews:
“Cart by Cart: Supermarket Simulator is a market simulation game where you run a little shop. You can buy shelving and refrigerators, stock items, and then ring up your customers to make money to keep everyone happy.”
LadiesGamers
